app.name: NovaMixer
view.applications.title: Applications

view.applications.empty.body: Anything that plays audio appears here on its own. You can also add an application now and set its level before you open it.
view.applications.noMatch.title: No matches
view.applications.unavailable.title: Audio is unavailable
view.applications.unavailable.body: NovaMixer could not reach the Windows audio service. It will keep trying.
view.groups.title: Groups
view.groups.subtitle: Set one volume for several applications at once, and apply it automatically when they start.
view.settings.title: Settings

view.about.title: About
view.about.subtitle: Version, licence, and where things live on disk.

master.label: Output

add.browseFailed: Could not open the file browser.

inspector.title: Settings for {app}
inspector.name: Name
inspector.nameHint: Shown instead of the name Windows reports. Leave it empty to restore the original.
inspector.rememberHint: Reapply {level} whenever this application starts playing.
inspector.pinHint: Keep this application above the rest of the list.
inspector.hideHint: Keep the settings but stop showing this application.
inspector.groupHint: A group applies one volume to every application in it.
inspector.identityWeak: Matched by file name only. Moving or reinstalling this application may require adding it again.
inspector.forgetBody: Removes this application's settings from NovaMixer. The application itself is not closed, changed, or uninstalled.
inspector.forgetConfirmBody: Its saved level and preferences are deleted. The application itself is not closed or uninstalled, and it will reappear here the next time it plays audio.
scene.label: Scenes
scene.captureBody: Stores every application's level exactly as it is right now, so you can bring it all back with one click.
scene.name: Scene name
scene.deleteConfirmBody: The scene is removed. Your current levels are not changed.
scene.emptyHint: Set your levels, then save them as a scene you can bring back in one click.
palette.title: Command palette
groups.addMemberHint: Choose which applications this group controls.
groups.noMembers: No applications yet. Add one to control it with this group.
groups.noCandidates: Every application is already in this group.
groups.startupVolumeHint: Apply this volume as soon as a member starts playing.
groups.autoMuteHint: Silence a member the moment it starts. Overrides the startup volume.
groups.hotkeysHint: Global volume hotkeys act on this group while it is active.
groups.deleteBody: The group is removed. The applications themselves are not affected.
groups.cannotDeleteLast: The last group cannot be deleted.
groups.empty.title: No groups yet
groups.empty.body: A group applies one volume to several applications, and can set it automatically when they launch.
settings.launchOnStartupHint: Open NovaMixer automatically when you sign in.
settings.startMinimizedHint: Open to the tray instead of showing the window.
settings.minimizeToTrayHint: Closing the window keeps NovaMixer running in the notification area.
settings.autoSaveHint: Write configuration to disk shortly after each change.
settings.efficiencyHint: Runs NovaMixer on Windows' efficiency cores so it stays out of the way. Task Manager shows the green leaf. Audio control keeps full speed.
settings.volumeStepHint: How much each volume hotkey press changes the level.
settings.smartVolumeHint: Use a smaller step when quiet and a larger one when loud.
settings.hotkeyConflict: That combination is already used by {action}.
settings.hotkeyTargetHint: Hotkeys control the active group, or the output volume when no group is active.
settings.dataFolderHint: Where NovaMixer stores your settings and its backup.
settings.restoreBackupHint: Replace the current configuration with the last saved backup.
settings.restoreBody: Your current applications, groups, and preferences are replaced by the previous saved copy.
